manual: U13 / 3.5: in backend/log.json the assist.askChart row has 0 < providerMs <= durationMs (backend checks have no numeric comparison). A durationMs over 30 000 where the AI service was not the cause is recorded for review with Vikram, not failed (3.5: a target, no maxMs).
